classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. The definitions and combining example support decomposing A according to membership in B.

content.prompt:
True or False? Let $A$ and $B$ be sets in a universal set $U$.

$(A\cap B)\cup(A\cap\overline B)=A$.

answer.worked: True. $A\cap B$ contains the elements of $A$ inside $B$, and $A\cap\overline B$ contains those outside $B$. Together these two parts contain all and only the elements of $A$.
